translations.web: Don’t go out into the field or walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side.
translations.bsb: Do not go out to the fields; do not walk the road. For the enemy has a sword; terror is on every side.
translations.kjv: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.
translations.asv: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy, and terror, are on every side.
